first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so simplifying onboarding addresses two current funnel problems and is supported by prior durable lifts in completion, time-to-value, and SMB activation. Verify memory_86 for downstream qualified-revenue evidence and memory_73 to compare the strongest response to competitor pricing before committing. Guard against improving completion while admitting lower-intent accounts.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified prior result directly matches the current completion decline and showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, supporting sustainable adoption rather than merely top-of-funnel growth. Promotional pricing is rejected despite competitive pressure because its qualified-revenue lift came with 30-day retention down 12% and failure by first renewal. Measure activation, retention, and qualified-revenue outcomes because the prior onboarding test did not directly establish long-term revenue impact.
